content: Implement repository layer for DELETE /api/users/:id with soft delete and audit trail
activeForm: Implementing repository layer for DELETE /api/users/:id with soft delete and audit trail
description: Implement user.repository.ts with softDeleteUser method that handles soft deletion by setting is_active=false. Implements database-level soft delete with transaction handling, audit trail creation, and proper constraint handling. Preserves all user data (no hard delete). Write 4 MVP-tier tests (integration tests for database operations, transactions, and audit records). This subtask provides the data access layer that will be used by the controller in T3.4.

checkpoints.name: Soft Delete Method Implementation Complete
checkpoints.requirement: Repository softDeleteUser method created with is_active flag update and transaction support

checkpoints.name: MVP Tests Passing with Audit Trail
checkpoints.requirement: All 4 tests passing (soft delete, transaction, audit, rollback verified)

phases.name: Repository Method Implementation
actions: Build: SQL UPDATE query to set is_active=false, updated_at=NOW()
Implement: Transaction support for atomic soft delete
Return: true if user found and deleted, false if user not found
phases.gate: Soft delete query must use transactions before proceeding

phases.name: Audit Trail Implementation
actions: Create: deletion_audit table entry (user_id, deleted_at, deleted_by)
Implement: Audit record creation within same transaction
Handle: User not found scenario (return false without audit)
Handle: Already deleted user (idempotent - return true)
Implement: Transaction rollback on audit failure

phases.name: MVP Test Suite (4 tests)
actions: Write: Test 1 - Successful soft delete sets is_active=false
Write: Test 2 - Soft delete creates audit record
Write: Test 3 - Transaction rollback on error
Write: Test 4 - Idempotent delete (already deleted user)
Verify: All 4 tests passing with 90%+ coverage of repository layer
